qualifying_purchase_rules.session_window: Begins on Special Link click; ends at the earliest of (x) 24 hours elapse, (y) the customer places an order for a non-digital Product, or (z) the customer clicks through a Special Link that is not yours.
qualifying_purchase_rules.cart_window: Add-to-cart orders must be completed no later than 89 days after the initial click-through of the Special Link.
qualifying_purchase_rules.fulfilment_window: Within 180 days of purchase the Product must be shipped to, streamed or downloaded by, and paid for by the customer.
qualifying_purchase_rules.qualifying_revenue: The amount Amazon actually receives from the Qualifying Purchase, less shipping charges, gift-wrapping fees, handling fees, taxes (e.g. sales tax and VAT), service charges, credits, rebates, credit card processing fees, and bad debt.
disqualified_examples: Product purchased after termination of your Agreement
Order where a cancellation, return, or refund has been initiated
Product purchased by a customer referred through a Prohibited Paid Search Placement (bidding on keywords containing 'amazon', 'kindle', or any other Amazon Mark, or variations/misspellings)
Product purchased by a customer referred by a link generated or displayed on a Search Engine (e.g. Google, Yahoo, Bing) or any site in such a network
Product purchased via a Redirecting Link that sends users indirectly to an Amazon Site without an affirmative click
Purchase not correctly tracked because the links from your site are not properly formatted
Product purchased through a Special Link in a Mobile Application that was not an Approved Mobile Application (or not served by Creators API / PA API)
Product subject to a Bounty Event
Product purchased as a subscription unless otherwise provided in the Agreement
Pre-release or pre-order Product that is not available on a Product listing page

per_asin_category_mapping.note: Amazon does not publish which commission category an individual ASIN falls into. All three products on this site are in the 'Home & Kitchen' department, and the official rate table contains both a 'Kitchen' row (4.50%) and a 'Home' row (3.00%). The applicable rate per ASIN must be read from Associates Central reports after a tag is connected. No rate is asserted per product.
